37026c14e750e273.title: Nondisruptive 3D profiling of combinations of epigenetic marks in single cells
digest: Epi-PHR is an imaging method that maps combinations of epigenetic marks at single genes while preserving 3D genome structure, revealing how chromatin folding and histone modifications are linked among single-chromatin copies.

5115cc08af6585a8.title: Altered protein cysteine reactivity in senescent cells is a vulnerability for senolysis to ameliorate aging
digest: Wu, Yang, Li and colleagues identify vanadyl sulfate, a dietary supplement, as a senolytic that targets altered cysteine reactivity in senescent cells, improving age-related conditions and extending lifespan in mice.

3c1248e2abf76b88.title: abcFISH enables multiplexed, single-molecule visualization of circular RNA spatial heterogeneity
digest: abcFISH is an imaging method for multiplexed, single‑molecule circular RNA detection in cells and in vivo, revealing single-cell expression heterogeneity and direct therapeutic efficacy of circular aptamers.

0f75e61d052809b9.title: Some follicles take the slow lane
digest: Liang and colleagues show that, in mice, activated oocytes can persist for almost a year within ovarian secondary follicles by adopting a state of reduced biosynthetic and metabolic activity.
Improved understanding of the mechanism that underpins how and when ovarian follicles persist has implications for the dynamics of female reproductive aging.

79365c1f8d837470.title: E11 Bio - Scientist I/II, Expansion Microscopy
digest: E11 Bio is on a mission to advance connectomics towards the scale of whole mammalian brains.
We are a collaborative and interdisciplinary team of scientists and engineers engaged in a neuroscience moonshot project to develop a radical technology platform for scalable brain mapping.

63458601fa6552c2.title: Deep and quantitative proteomic profiling of low-volume mouse serum in a cross-sectional analysis of aging
digest: To address the technically challenging task of profiling the age-associated blood proteome in sample-limited mouse studies, the authors present a quantitative nanoparticle-based enrichment workflow coupled with data-independent acquisition mass spectrometry to identify key age-associated circulating proteins with relevance to human health.

9e497f5df2b555cc.title: Tsitsi Dangarembga gives Gates Cambridge Annual Lecture
digest: Award-winning author Tsitsi Dangarembga delivered the eighth Gates Cambridge Annual Lecture at St John’s Divinity School last night, giving the audience an exclusive insight into her latest non-fiction book.

Tsitsi Dangarembga before the Annual Lecture Her talk was entitled The Circular and the Linear: A Southern Africanist (Re)Construction of the World and covered external, internal and meta colonisation and the impact of European ideas about wealth and society on today’s world.

58bdb5730f5e3076.title: Controller
digest: Convergent Research is a non-profit science studio best known for pioneering the Focused Research Organization (FRO): a startup-style team built to tackle one ambitious scientific problem that academia and industry can’t.
We’re launching moonshot science projects which may change the trajectory of scientific progress.

07d30d200896609b.title: Recordanelles capture transient gene expression in single human cells
digest: RNA sequencing can capture high-resolution snapshots of a cell’s transcriptome, but transient changes in individual cells cannot be captured over long periods at a transcriptome-wide scale.
Now, a synthetic organelle termed the ‘recordanelle’ can record cellular RNAs in cells for several days and be read with single-cell sensitivity.

3b08ebf26aca6aa7.title: Deep dynamical models of single-cell multiomic velocities predict loss-of-function and rescue perturbations in B cells
digest: DynaVelo integrates single-cell omics data to infer cell state dynamics and regulatory interactions.

b72e592ade2a402c.title: Oocyte-specific OMC1 is required for maintaining chromosome cohesion through reproductive life
digest: Mammalian oocytes undergo prolonged meiotic arrest during which sister chromatids are linked by cohesin complexes.
Cohesion deterioration during aging results in aneuploidy.
